design.rationale: Original widescreen cinema-ribbon interpretation of the Electric Type pin from the verified 2026-09-27 saved-pin snapshot; the public board was inaccessible, so this is not a new observation. A midnight cobalt stage, projector-yellow live type and restrained red leader marks reorganize the complete deck into ticket navigation, a poster-scale hero with a separate metric rail, ribboned study modules, a horizontal production roadmap, framed resources, paired film cards and bold logbook folios without copying the reference artwork.
